56/G.goal: Explain the computer-graphics foundations of VR rendering and resource optimization by describing the 3D graphics pipeline, geometric transformations, and the lighting-to-intensity mapping process.
56/G.achieves: It provides the foundational understanding of rendering required to identify where computational and display resources are used and to address resource-optimization issues later in the course.

56/O1.goal: Explain how the 3D graphics pipeline supports VR rendering, including its five stages and how modeling and composite transformations convert local-coordinate objects into world-space vertices.
56/O1.achieves: It gives the learner a foundation for recognizing the geometric stages of rendering that contribute to VR resource requirements and for making informed choices when implementing scene transformations.

56/O2.goal: Describe how lighting models compute ambient, diffuse, and specular intensities, extend those computations with attenuation, colored and multiple light sources, and map continuous intensities to finite device pixel values.
56/O2.achieves: It lets the learner understand the computational and display-related aspects of image formation that must be considered when analyzing and optimizing VR rendering resources.
